description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Profile' which provides a user interface for managing user profile details, such as display name and roles. It interacts with external APIs to load, save, and recompute profile data, handles various UI states like loading, saving, and errors, and utilizes hooks for state management and side effects.

methods.description: React functional component enabling profile management, including loading current data, editing, saving, and recalculating profile KPIs.
